title: SPHINX IN A GOWN — house master of the founder's Gemini strike

provenance.engine: Gemini (Lyria), struck by the founder himself
provenance.prompt: the desk's production spec + the founder's bars — NIGHT SUN sheet, Verses I-II (Lady Lilith, the Mother Tongue), ~/workspace/goals/qasparr-the-unfriendly-ghost-album/files/NIGHT-SUN-77-BARS.md
provenance.struck: 2026-11-10, uploaded by the founder the same day
provenance.ruling: adoption, 2026-11-10 — Gemini strikes; the desk measures, masters, notates, records
provenance.audio_custody: local only — rented-engine reference audio does not enter git (house rule)

width.reason: near-mono strike, vocal centred in the side signal's little remainder; no stems exist; any widening on this desk would move the vocal image with the bed. In doubt, leave it — confessed.

sigma.reason: whether Sigma rides a Gemini strike is the founder's open call, not the desk's; no layer was presumed. The strike itself carries no certifiable discrete Sigma layer (see analysis-stats.json, sigma_probe).

notes: loudness is K-weighted integrated, UNGATED (BS.1770 gating omitted in the house scales, stated not hidden).

the ceiling is law: had the true-peak trim taken the master below the loudness target, master.ceiling_overrode_loudness would say so in the open. In the event it did not: the struck render was hot (sample peak -0.01 dBFS, true peak +0.01 dBTP), but the -0.6 dB gain to target plus the soft limiter's bend brought the true peak to -1.17 dBTP — under the ceiling with trim_db 0.0. The loudness target stands met exactly and the ceiling never had to overrule it; both facts are in the master block, not in this prose.
no head or tail fades: those belong to the performance chain's assembly of takes; an intake master of a finished render leaves the waveform's edges as struck.
nothing rides and nothing was removed: no Sigma, no EQ, no width process, no edit of any kind between decode and the loudness/ceiling law.
